purpose: Content-level inspection only, not PySD parity, not a permit to connect and execute.

DoingWork.mdl.interpretation: Existing work is consumed at a constant rate when workforce and productivity are constant; no stop at zero and no arrival of newly accepted work.

BuildingInvDoingWork.mdl.interpretation: Represents accumulating finished inventory; it has no endogenous customer-order shipping or make-to-order constraint.

produc.mdl.interpretation: Static workforce × productivity flow, not a complete order-production-stock relationship.

equations_excerpt: Workforce = INTEG(Hiring and Firing, Desired People)
Hiring and Firing = Worker Shortage / time to hire or fire
Desired People = Desired Accomplishing Rate / productivity
b2workf.mdl.interpretation: Desired workforce from output target; not a queue service rule.

doingWorkCascade.mdl.interpretation: A multi-stage inventory cascade; production flows defined from workforce and productivity, without automatic downstream-capacity protection.

equations_excerpt: Productive Capacity = INTEG(FinishingConstruction-Retiring Capacity, Desired Capacity)
Construction In Process = INTEG(Starting Construction-FinishingConstruction,Target Construction In Process)
c2capord.mdl.interpretation: Adjustment/construction of productive capacity, not directly 15-minute restaurant service capacity.

equations_excerpt: Old material = INTEG(Material aging-Material flowing out, ...)
tcasccof.mdl.interpretation: Age cohorts of material and characteristic, not backlog shipping.
